name: push_cart
text: A person steadily walks straight forward pushing a shopping cart, with both hands continuously on the cart handle in front of the abdomen. Elbows relaxed and bent, forearms extending forward. Regular alternating walking steps, upright torso, maintain both grips, no turning or releasing.

trim.reason: Middle complete gait cycle of three constrained cycles; removes transient end-cycle grip overshoot. No joint editing or time scaling.

review.reason: 生成后按成人火柴人和购物车实际握点逐帧验收；取中间完整周期，双手最大误差分别3.65、4.36厘米。正侧面、源手部近景及最快摆脚的连续帧已检查。
review.known_limitations: 源手指保持模型固定放松形状，不宣称精细抓握。映射脚尖最低约-0.83厘米；接缝姿势闭合，但未承诺速度一阶连续。
review.constraint_note: 全身仅19/199帧，间隔11帧；另加局部双手约束。目标肘腕按现有映射求解，源骨段长度和全局旋转保持一致。临时参考已清理时仍可从constraint_targets还原约束值。
